messages:
press-bot: :warning: Alert: TechDaily published our benchmark story ~2m ago and included raw comparison tables before embargo lift. Link: https://techdaily.example/article/early-post

morgan (pr): What?! Were those our raw tables or an excerpt?

press-bot: It looks like a direct screenshot of the 'results' CSV from the draft assets folder.

alex (legal): Immediate action: do not call the reporter. PR should email and ask for a correction and temporary takedown of the raw tables. I'll draft a DMCA-style notice if needed.

nora (product): Are the raw tables confidential? I thought the blog had embargoed public tables but maybe drafts were too discoverable. We need to confirm sensitivity.

morgan (pr): Reporter says they received an "advance copy" from a third party. I'm drafting an email: ask to remove the raw tables, hold the rest under embargo, and confirm they will republish only at 09:00 PT.

alex (legal): Draft line: "We request immediate removal of embargoed material (raw benchmark tables) that was published prior to the agreed embargo time. Please confirm removal and that the remainder will be held until 09:00 PT." I can sign.

tim (growth): Social ops: pause any scheduled posts globally until we confirm. We don't want to amplify an incomplete or leaked view.

sasha (social-ops): Pausing now. All scheduled posts set to emergency hold.

morgan (pr): Sent email to reporter and cc'ed editor. Using firm but non-litigious tone.

press-bot: :inbox_tray: Email sent (ID: 2026-03-27-TD-001). Reporter replied: "We're looking into it and will remove the tables ASAP. Will confirm."

alex (legal): Good. Keep a log of timestamps/screenshots of the early publish for record. I'll assemble a short timeline in case of further escalation.

nora (product): Quick technical note: can eng confirm whether the draft CSV was accidentally uploaded to the public assets bucket? If so we need a postmortem with permissions fix.

morgan (pr): I'll loop infra and eng. Tagging eng-sre in a separate thread.

ceo (exec-comm): Please update me if the outlet refuses to remove the tables. If we need to escalate publicly, coordinate with legal and product.

press-bot: :white_check_mark: TechDaily confirmed removal and said they'll hold until 09:00 PT. They apologized and credited our request.

morgan (pr): Closing for now but opening a follow-up to audit asset permissions and review embargo distribution list. Thanks team.
